name: Basilisk Art: Formation of One Thousand Snakes

system.description:
You release a series of blade swings so swiftly that you create the visage of thousand snakes coiling around you and striking out at all creatures of your choice in a 15-foot cube originating from you. Affected creatures in range must make a Dexterity saving throw. Taking [Weapon Damage] and 1 rank of Bleed or half as much damage on a successful save.

Serpent Coil. This jutsu can be cast as a Reaction, to taking damage from a hostile creatures Ninjutsu, Taijutsu or Bukijutsu. If cast in this way, this jutsu gains the Clash keyword and initiates a clash with the triggering effect.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d6.
